notes.title: 2024.11.22 Update
notes.notes: The pixel h animation has been put into the free battle mode. You can view it freely after unlocking it.

notes.title: 2024.11.15 v1.0.10 update
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience! We have resolved the issue that prevented some players from running the game properly. Please enjoy the newly added defeat HCG scenes, carefully prepared by our developers.

Due to differences in the production process, the new content does not include full voice acting. We hope for your understanding and appreciate your continued support!

notes.title: 2024.10.16 v1.0.7 update
notes.notes:
All tutorials can be viewed on the recall page.
The weapon upgrade has been changed to a permanent effect, which can be used as long as it is upgraded.
The drop rules for energy coins have been changed

notes.title: 2024.10.14 v1.0.6 update
notes.notes:
Added some Korean and Japanese UI
Fix some scattered bugs

notes.title: 2024.10.13 v1.0.5 update
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue of Day2 Boss battle crashing
Fixed an error after defeating a special shop boss in the battle

notes.title: 2024.10.13 v1.0.4 update
notes.notes:
Added the function of resetting archives (unlocked CGs will be retained)
Fixed some Chinese voice playback errors that caused the process to get stuck.

notes.title: 2024.10.12 v1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
Fixed some Korean display errors
Fixed some monster memories not unlocking properly
Unlocking the boss's memories no longer requires dying once, just kill the monster to unlock
